main_text.p: הם המוצהירם והכאסכים שראוי [?] לממיר עלירם [?] qvod autoritate duorum antiqvorum Rabbinorum confirmat, R. Abraham Ben Dir & R. Mosis Bar Nachman; præ cæteris celebres, fuerunt in punctatione, Ben Asher & Ben Nephtali, hic orientalis, iste occidentalis; ficut igitur post priores Masorethas, Babylonii eorum opus recensuerunt, & varias differentias adnotarunt; ita postqvam alii Masorethæ puncta inseripserunt, Babylonii punctationem istam examinaverunt, atqve in nonnullis ab ea discesserunt.

Verùm Ben Asher pro Masorethis stans in nonnullis R. Nephtali Babyloniorum capiti non cessit, hincq; orta est celeberrima apud Judæos de certis punctationibus differentia. Hæc tantum commemoravi, ut appareat, priores Masorethas, qvorum recensitionem habemus, nihil de punctis cogitasse, alioqvin ut postea factum, & rectè adnotavit Elias, aliqvid in eorum punctatione reprehendisse Babylonii, cùm textum ab iis emendatum lustrarunt; ab eo tem-

page.notes: The two Hebrew lines at the head are only partly legible; the words marked [?] are my best reading and should be checked against the scan. The printed "Mofis" is transcribed as "Mosis" (long s rule). The catchword "pore" is read from a partly obscured word and is marked as printed. The line "reprehendisse" may have been printed differently; the scan is faint there.
